_about: Soft signal for the private digest: a listed company gets the tier's points and label. A tier with "show_label": false scores the same but never prints its label in the digest. A company on no list is never dropped for that reason.
Matching is exact on the normalized name or an alias (case, punctuation and Inc/LLC/Corp suffixes ignored), never a substring, so add every spelling the boards use to 'aliases'.

The bar is Microsoft/NVIDIA new-grad compensation. Comp figures come from speedyapply's Salary column (https://github.com/speedyapply/2027-SWE-College-Jobs, NEW_GRAD_USA.md and README.md, read 2026-11-08), which lists one figure per company: NVIDIA new grad $172k/yr, Microsoft intern $52/hr, NVIDIA intern $62/hr.
levels.fyi figures marked 'verified' were read on 2026-11-08; levels.fyi blocked further requests that day, so other levels.fyi links are unverified pointers.
